notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{U}{R}.
description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the copy of Rude Awakening, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}{R}.
Resolve Rude Awakening, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of Rootha.
When Lore Drakkis enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rude Awakening from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Lore Drakkis
uses.cardState: mutated on top of or below Rootha
